# The timeline column draws its bars 0 px tall in a plain grid

## Context

I found this while reading the planning groups for the slate ([#21142, renew row 1](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21142#issuecomment-6946390423)). `examples/timeline/basic` is the timeline column's only example outside a scheduler, and it shows seven teams over an empty day. Its 12 intervals do render, but each is 2 px tall. The catalog record promises "A plain grid mounting the timeline column with interval bars". #21039's AC-1 asked for exactly that frame, and #21044 merged without a screenshot of it.

Design authority: `Neo.timeline.Column` extends `Neo.grid.column.Base` (its JSDoc), so it is a column any grid can mount. #21039's example and #21195's guide both build on that.

## The Problem

Measured in a browser at 1440 × 900 on `dev` `37c0a995dc`:
- The grid cell is 48 px tall.
- Inside it, `.neo-timeline-cell` has no height of its own and collapses to 0.
- `.neo-timeline-track { height: 100% }` therefore resolves to 0.
- The bars' inline `height: 84%; top: 8%` leaves only their 2 px of border.

The scheduler and the Gantt chart never show this, because both add `.neo-timeline-cell { height: 100%; width: 100% }` inside their own containers. No spec loads the example.

## The Architectural Reality

- `resources/scss/src/timeline/Column.scss` styles `.neo-timeline-cell` (box sizing, overflow, padding, position), but not its size.
- `resources/scss/src/scheduler/Container.scss` and `resources/scss/src/gantt/Container.scss` each repair it in their own scope. So a sizing rule the column owns is stated twice, outside it.
- #21225 converts every Sass source to plain CSS, this file included. Whichever of the two lands second carries the change over.

## The Fix

1. In `resources/scss/src/timeline/Column.scss`, `.neo-timeline-cell` gets `height: 100%; width: 100%`.
2. Delete the two container copies. The rule lives with the column.
3. Add an e2e spec that loads `examples/timeline/basic` and asserts that each bar takes the height its row gives it. The spec fails on `dev`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] In `examples/timeline/basic` at 1440 × 900, all 12 bars render at the height their row gives them, in every theme the example declares (five). A spec fails on `dev` and passes with the fix.
- [ ] The scheduler and Gantt examples render as before, with their `.neo-timeline-cell` copies removed, and their e2e specs stay green.
- [ ] The pull request shows the example before and after.

## Out of Scope

The example's content, which the slate decides (#21142); the timeline guide (#21195).
